name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative
description: Empowering women Self-Help Group (SHG) members to earn sustainable annual income of ₹1 Lakh or more through micro-enterprises.
benefits: Interest-free loan up to ₹5 Lakh, entrepreneurship & financial training, market linkage support

criteria.disqualification_reason: Lakhpati Didi initiative is strictly for women

criteria.description: Must be resident in rural area / part of rural SHG
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant is not in rural jurisdiction

criteria.description: Must be an active member of a Self-Help Group (SHG)
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant is not an active member of a Self-Help Group (SHG)
